entries.name: warren rat
entries.description: Fat on alms-bread and worse. Quick, and never alone for long.

entries.name: catalogued dead
entries.description: A skeleton with a tithe number stamped into its skull. It still keeps the appointment.

entries.name: cultist of the false sun
entries.description: A devotee of the hooked wheel. Believes your suffering is a holy duty, theirs to perform.

entries.name: ghoul
entries.description: What the ossuaries make of the hungry. Slow, patient, and very strong.

entries.name: Preliator Sentinel
entries.description: The warden of the Sealed Stair, black iron and imperial purple. Measured, tireless, sure it is holy.
